ModMetaData.description:
Search and Rescue
For RimWorld 1.6 · Alpha
Batch-mark downed pawns or animals for treatment, evacuation, and capture. Pawns assigned to the Field Rescue work type will coordinate the response efficiently, including on-site first aid, bulk medical-supply delivery, division of labor, and injury-based prioritization.
This is an Alpha release and the mod is still in early development. Back up long-running saves before adding it.
Features
• Three stackable designations: field treatment, rescue, and capture. The default shortcut applies every valid stage to the selected targets at once. • Two ways to issue orders: choose a command and drag over casualties, or select casualties first and use the command in their bottom action bar. • A dedicated Field Rescue work type: sets the overall priority of battlefield rescue, with Doctor, Hauling and other relevant work types enabling individual tasks. • Unified triage and matching: assigns patients to doctors, nurses, and carriers using injury severity, blood loss, infection and immunity progress, distance, skill, work priority, current jobs, and switching costs. • Stabilize first, finish later: emergency care addresses immediate lethal threats. Treatment reactivates if the patient deteriorates, while ordinary wounds on stable patients are handled at a lower priority. • Coordinated rescue: when doctors are scarce, casualties can be evacuated first. An arriving doctor may intercept a casualty for treatment, while carriers decide whether to wait or help someone else based on the estimated treatment time. • Battlefield medical logistics: calculates medicine, blood, and special-device budgets from each casualty's actual shortage. Doctors weigh whether a supply detour is worthwhile, while carriers can deliver missing supplies. • Player control: manually ordered treatment, carrying, and capture take priority and retain the player’s chosen targets. • Supports treatment and rescue for friendly humanlikes and non-hostile animals. Capture applies to humanlikes only. Colony mechs support repair and evacuation to the rescue point; mechanitors enable Field Rescue and Smithing.
